p1: Every night at 3 a.m., I wake up frozen.
A man in a black hat stands at the end of my bed. Closer every night.
It started a month ago. The week my girlfriend Mia moved in.
My doctor said it's sleep paralysis. People call him the Hat Man.
Mia smiled. She said she'd seen him for years.
He's harmless, babe. He just needs someone to watch.
Last night, I froze again. His face was an inch from mine.
And Mia was awake beside me. Smiling.
She stroked my hair and whispered to him...
See? I told you you'd like this one.
Mia hasn't seen him since she moved in. She gave him to me.
I left Mia. The Hat Man came with me.
I found a flatmate. He moves in Friday.
Follow. And don't look at the end of your bed.
